purpose: Test lower-variance B1a-anchored probability corrections after NL1 failed untouched pooled-log-loss and meeting-stability criteria.
architecture: For each rider, start from log(p_B1a). Candidate corrections add a regularized linear term. A blend feature is log(p_NL1)-log(p_B1a); numeric rider features are within-race population z-scores. Final probabilities are within-race softmax. This anchors every candidate to the frozen B1a distribution rather than replacing it unconstrained.

evaluation.method: leave-one-meeting-out over all labelled development meetings
evaluation.optimizer: deterministic L-BFGS-B from zero correction weights
evaluation.winner_rule: Among eligible candidates choose lowest pooled held-out log loss; tie-break by more meetings improving B1a, then lower worst-meeting log loss, then lexical candidate id.
evaluation.if_none_eligible: FAIL_DEVELOPMENT_SEARCH_NO_CANDIDATE; do not manufacture a winner.

post_selection_rule: If a winner exists, fit it once on all labelled development races and freeze exact coefficients/model-core hash. The failed NL1 validation meetings are development-only after this preregistration and can never be reused as untouched validation for NL2.
future_validation_rule: Any NL2 confirmatory claim requires a newly preregistered collision-audited meeting-disjoint historical universe not in any development source or prior exposed validation boundary, with predictions frozen before dedicated result scoring.

integrity_caveat.dry_run_scope: Same three exposed development artifacts and same fixed candidate family/eligibility rule were executed locally to verify runner correctness before the protocol file was canonicalized.
integrity_caveat.scientific_effect: This development phase cannot be described as preregistered. It remains exploratory/development-only. Any confirmatory model claim requires a fresh validation rule committed before target outcome access.
